$comment: This instance's agent config — uploaded to the per-instance config bucket root at deploy time. Edit values here to customise the instance. Secrets (gemini.api_keys) come from Secret Manager via the GEMINI_API_KEYS_SECRET env var; the array is a shape contract only and must never carry a value here. Note query_param_key is omitted deliberately: with none set, ?key= overrides and demo mode are disabled outright. Add your own non-guessable value only if you need demo links, and never reuse one across instances. See the Customising section of README.md.

mcp._comment: Local-development default only. A deployed instance gets MCP_SERVER_URL from Terraform, pointing at the data-plane service, and the env var wins over this value. Leaving localhost here means a laptop run still finds a local MCP server, and it is never the value that ships.

knowledge_base._comment: Disabled by default. To enable RAG: (1) provision a Gemini File Search corpus at aistudio.google.com, (2) upload your reference documents to it, (3) paste the corpus ID into gemini.filestores[] above, (4) set enabled to true.

template_vars._comment: Substituted into {{instance.*}} placeholders in prompts/. Set these to your own deployment's identity.
template_vars.name: Example Data Commons
